resources.string: Choose your profile. A local PIN protects photos each time you reopen the app.
Use 6–12 digits and enter the same PIN twice.
Could not unlock. Check your PIN. After 5 attempts, wait 30 seconds; repeated attempts may require up to 5 minutes.
Remove this profile from this TV? Photos and the account on your Immich server will not be deleted. You will need the API key to add it again.

Forgot your PIN? Remove the local profile and add it again using your API key. The PIN is only a TV lock, not your Immich password. Background photo screensavers are disabled; preview works while unlocked.
Security upgrade: please add your account again with its server address, API key and a new PIN. Your server photos are unchanged.
